Queries with a null-valued placeholder are skipped and reported, never guessed.

evidence_rules.note: If a fact cannot be quoted from a retrievable source, it is recorded as 'unknown' — never as a soft assumption.

vetting_checklist._comment: Run before a target is promoted past 'discovered'. Feeds the suspicious_website / unclear_company_identity penalties.
checks: Physical address present and plausible (not a mail drop or residential-only)
Phone answers / is a real business line
Business registered with a Secretary of State (or foreign equivalent)
Inventory photos are original, not stock or copied from another dealer
Prices are within a plausible band of market — far-below-market is a scam marker
Payment terms: wire-only or crypto-only is a hard flag
For overseas suppliers: verified supplier status, audit reports, trade assurance
